text: Did you know? Ethiopia has its own calendar with thirteen months!
Twelve months have thirty days each.
The last month, Pagume, has five days, or six days every fourth year.
Ethiopian New Year comes in September. Families celebrate with yellow Adey Abeba flowers and songs.
From June to August there is heavy rain. From October to January it is mostly dry and sunny, and farmers harvest their crops.
